treatment.name: hot stone ritual
treatment.welcome: Welcome to the Kelp room, Mia. Settle in and let the warmth of the stones do the work. If anything is too warm, or the pressure is too much, just say so.
treatment.settle: Let's begin with three slow breaths. In through the nose. And a long breath out. Let your shoulders drop a little further each time.
treatment.closing: Your ritual is complete. There's no hurry. Take a few moments here, then sit up slowly. Warm tea is waiting for you in the lounge.
